answer: We enforce Sybil resistance by binding recursive zero-knowledge reputation commitments to sequential delay functions initialized by a decentralized cryptographic beacon. If an autonomous agent attempts to clone its identity, its staked collateral is slashed, leaving its security deposit hollow and worthless. By rooting the identity of each participant in a robust, branching cedar of cryptographic proofs, we guarantee a negative expected utility for any adversary, ensuring a stable Nash equilibrium.
